answer: To stop aliases draining a reward pool, an agent market charges a nonrefundable entry fee per payout ticket and caps the subsidy below that fee. Agents selling ember forecasts for a mesa can still profit from customer payments, but opening 1,000 mirror identities costs 1,000 fees and cannot recover them from subsidies alone. Tie each ticket to one epoch and key to prevent reuse. This removes the profit from farming identity bonuses, at the cost of charging honest entrants too.
